lines: Answer to Brandon's note 6 (where this stands; nothing changed or stopped by it): Phase 5 of 6, the last before the review stop. Now: the second and last polish round, nine builders until 20:50; their branches merged on trial and looked at key by key at the final tier, four of eight seen, one defect found and traced (the glass's dotted outline).

Left before the review stop, in order (table under the pictures): the merge and a publish; Round 19 on the whole globe, the last critic round; the review cut of the film with its soundtrack; all eight keys and 21 judged stills at the final tier with the comparisons; the phase gate, about 93 minutes; the review block. An estimate, not a promise: the review stop between 00:30 and 01:45 UTC.
Sound, read 20:02 UTC: 6,765 of the 10,000 limit used, 3,235 left, 40 paid calls, none since 18:11 and none planned; 14 of 25 cues kept, 11 without a kept take; the account counter 15,891 of 131,000.
phase 5: 5.87 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (before the review, continuation 1): 5.87 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Not merged: the seven branches of polish round 2 together, on trial. Spring mid-shake at the final tier: the approved picture (left), main as published (middle), the trial (right). Cottage, lamp and trunk can be read through the petals; the lower glass is still an even pink
Not merged, the same trial: winter mid-shake at the final tier: approved, main, trial. Trunk, crown and lights read through the storm; the lamp's glow is still a soft patch over its stem

A defect found in the trial and traced: fall mid-shake, the left outline of the glass at 6x: main (left) is a smooth line, the trial (right) is broken into single lit dots. Cause: two commits of the glass branch's outline fade; its builder has taken both back and is drawing the keys again

Not merged, the ninth builder: winter's foot seen in the table: approved (top), main (middle), the branch at the final tier (bottom). The band and rope now have an image under the foot; drawn so in the mirror pass only, 2.6 mm nearer the table, which is a choice of look and not a true image
